# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster acquires complete understanding of any bone damage, including the tools
and methods required for healing. Caster does not receive the skill or power
to perform the cure.
@@ 3
Allows caster to mend one simple fracture (not compound fractures, shatters,
joint damage, etc.). Recovery time is one day.
@@ 4
Allows caster to repair all cartilage damage around one joint. Recovery time
is one day.
@@ 5
Allows caster to prevent the deterioration of one limb (even if severed). Also
requires the use of the same spell from Nerve Law, Muscle Law, and Blood Law.
@@ 6
As Minor Fracture Repair, except that the caster can also repair compound
fractures. Recovery time is one day.
@@ 8
Allows caster to mend one fracture in a skull (but not a shattered area).
Recovery time is 1d10 days (depending on the damage).
@@ 10
Allows caster to repair one broken (but not shattered) joint. Recovery time is
1d10 days.
@@ 11
As Minor Fracture Repair, except recovery is instantaneous.
@@ 12
Allows caster to reattach a limb. Requires the use of Muscle Law, Blood Law,
and Nerve Law Joining spells to restore functional status. Limb is fully
functional in 10-100 days.
@@ 13
As Cartilage Repair, except recovery time is instantaneous.
@@ 14
As Major Fracture Repair, except recovery time is instantaneous.
@@ 15
As Skull Repair, except recovery time is instantaneous.
@@ 16
As Joint Repair, except recovery time is instantaneous.
@@ 17
Allows caster to repair any broken or shattered bone. Requires a 10 minute
operation and 1-10 days recovery time.
@@ 18
As Minor Fracture Repair, except it repairs one minor fracture per level of
the caster. Spell operates as long as caster concentrates; each mended
fracture requires a one day recovery period.
@@ 20
As Mass Minor Fracture Repair, except it repairs cartilage (as in Cartilage
Repair).
@@ 25
As Joining, except that the limb is fully functional in 10 minutes (provided
that the caster also uses the other three Joining True spells).
@@ 30
As Mass Minor Fracture Repair, except for the range and it repairs major
fractures (as in Major Fracture Repair).
@@ 50
As Mass Minor Fracture Repair, except for the range and it repairs any broken
or shattered bone (as in Shatter Repair).
